name: 15613 · Apollo, PA
findings: ZIP 15613 (Apollo) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15613 (Apollo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
